title: Speed: a journey in two parts
question: Mr Tan drove for 3 hours at 70 km/h. Then he drove for 2 more hours at 55 km/h. How far did he drive altogether?

relations.from: Mr Tan drove for 3 hours at 70 km/h
he drove for 2 more hours at 55 km/h
How far did he drive altogether

timeline.say: Mr Tan drove for 3 hours at 70 km/h. Then he drove for 2 more hours at 55 km/h. How far did he drive altogether?
First, 3 hours at 70 kilometres every hour.
Then 2 more hours at 55 kilometres every hour.
Let's draw the journey on a line: 3 hours first, then 2 more hours.
Pause and think. How far did he go in the first 3 hours?
3 hours at 70 km/h. 3 times 70 is 210 kilometres.
After 5 hours, Mr Tan is 320 kilometres from the start.
Let's check: the second part is 110 kilometres, which is 2 times 55. It works!
So, Mr Tan drove 320 kilometres altogether. Well done!
